SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 8032
Special Branch - CS6 Station, 28 7 37
REPORT
Date July 28, 1937.

Subject Maurice HONEL, French Communist deputy.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S. Pitts.

（批：x arriving here on July 28, 1937.）

It was learned this morning that among the passengers from Marseilles to Hongkong on the Messageries Maritimes m.m. "Jean Laborde" was a French communist deputy named Maurice HONEL. Aged 34 years this man travelled second class and spent a part of his time on board in spreading communistic doctrines among the crew of the vessel. The purser of the "Jean Laborde" stated that he advised the police authorities in Colombo, Singapore and Saigon of this individual's activities. He is said to have put up at the Peninsula Hotel, Kowloon (Hongkong), after leaving the ship, and according to information received it is intention to proceed to Canton, Haiphong and possibly North China before returning to Haiphong and Saigon and then to France.

The trip he is making is not being financed by the French Government but by the French Communist Party and it is reported that it is his object to spend most of his time in the dissemination of communistic propaganda.

（批：Capt K Mr Stepton）

（印：29 JULY 1937 SHANGHAI）

D.S. Pitts -
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch).

（批：Copy sent. DR 29/7）
